repositories.description: AI-powered job application framework built on Claude Code. Fork it, fill in your profile, and let Claude evaluate jobs, tailor CVs, write cover letters, and prepare you for interviews.

repositories.description: OfficeCLI is the first and best Office suite purpose-built for AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files. Free, open-source, single binary, no Office installation required.

repositories.description: A TTS that fits in your CPU (and pocket)

repositories.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
